# DECK / divider
> DECK / divider is a specialized Pokémon TCG collection tracker, PSA/BGS/CGC slab registry, and 60-card tournament deck builder. It features live TCGplayer market prices and offline-first IndexedDB privacy.

## Core Capabilities
- **Collection Tracker**: Multi-currency valuation (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD), master set checklists (Regular, Reverse Holo, Masterball Holo, SIRs), and sealed booster box tracking.
- **Slab Vault**: Log PSA, BGS, CGC, and ACE grading certs, subgrades (Centering, Surface, Corners, Edges), and auction comps.
- **Deck Studio**: 60-card tournament deck builder with regulation mark legality checks (Standard H/I/J, Expanded, GLC) and 1-click export to Pokémon TCG Live (PTCGL).
- **Edge SSR Routing**: Full Cloudflare edge-side injection of SEO metadata, making every user portfolio, deck, and set readable by crawlers.
- **Privacy First**: 100% offline-ready IndexedDB vault with encrypted cloud backup for Pro users.

## Key Sections
- [Knowledge & Directory Hub](https://deckdivider.app/directory): Comprehensive directory of all sets, meta decks, graded slabs, and glossary.
- [Official Socials & Community Reviews](https://deckdivider.app/socials): Official Reddit (r/DeckDivider), Instagram (@deckdivider), and X (@DeckDivider) community channels with reviews and ratings.
- [Sets Directory](https://deckdivider.app/sets): Complete checklists for all official Pokémon TCG expansions.
- [Format Legality](https://deckdivider.app/formats): Standard, Expanded, and Gym Leader Challenge (GLC) rotation rules.
- [PSA Grade Calculator](https://deckdivider.app/tool/psa-grade-calculator): Expected Value (EV) and grading profitability calculator.
- [Deck Legality Checker](https://deckdivider.app/tool/deck-legality-checker): Verify regulation marks and 4-copy limits for tournaments.
- [Competitor Comparisons](https://deckdivider.app/compare): Feature-by-feature comparisons with Collectr, Pokellector, PriceCharting, and Dex.
- [Best Of Guides](https://deckdivider.app/best): Curated rankings of Pokémon card apps and scanning tools.
- [Pricing](https://deckdivider.app/pricing): Transparent freemium model with unlimited free local tier and optional Pro Cloud sync.
- [AI Keyword & Search Taxonomy](https://deckdivider.app/llms-keywords.txt): Structured index of all card rarities, query parameters, and long-tail terms.

- AI Search Matrix: https://deckdivider.app/search-matrix.json
- AI Keywords Index: https://deckdivider.app/llms-keywords.txt
- Card Pricing Source: TCGplayer Lowest Verified & eBay Completed Auctions
- Supported Slabs: PSA, BGS (Beckett), CGC, ACE, ARS
- Formats Verified: Standard (Regulation Marks H, I, J), Expanded (Black & White onwards), GLC (Singleton)
- Export Format: Standard PTCGL copy-paste deck format
